name: EarthPath
height_note: H 0..65535 spans height_range_m; mid level about 0.423

colour_spaces.N: linear, OpenGL (+Y up); flip green on Unreal import
colour_spaces.ORM: linear; R AO, G roughness, B metallic 0
colour_spaces.Macro: linear; R large, G medium, B small low-frequency variation, sample at 1/6 to 1/10 of the tile UV scale

method: Poly Haven dirt_floor (2x2, compacted earth with dry crazing) height-blended with rocky_trail (2x2, embedded stones and grit) plus a periodic footprint-scale undulation with damp hollows
known_weaknesses: no explicit wheel ruts or readable footprints (kept direction-free so it tiles under any path shape); stones are at most a few centimetres
